name: Tiebar
description: A frame with one diagonal tie run across the opening.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border: calc(4px * 6 / @size-col) solid var(--color1); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -20%; right: -20%; top: 50%; height: calc(4px * 6 / @size-col); background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
